text:
jess: FYI opened PR #813 to add a small SDK snippet showing trace->dashboard mapping and a migration note for the new trace label names. requesting docs and link-check review :eyes:

mike: link? I can run the local docs build and check examples quickly

jess: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/813 - includes Python async snippet + JS snippet + a short migration blurb. also added a redirect for the old GUID-based URL (still needs verification).

link-checker-bot: automated: new PR detected. running link checks and sample build. results will post here when done.

tara: quick glance — the migration blurb renames `trace_id` to `traceKey` but our SDK uses `trace_key` in examples elsewhere. we should pick one canonical variant.

andrew: agree with tara. upstream runtime field is `traceKey` (camelCase) in RPC payloads, but SDK surfaces `trace_key` in Python. docs should show both mapping and recommended SDK param.

jess: good catch. I'll update the migration note to show a mapping table and add both examples.

mike: the Python snippet fails lint in the PR preview because of an unused import. small fix. also missing screenshot for the dashboard layout — can we add an SVG export?

jess: will remove the import and export an SVG. adding that now.

jess: code snippet I'm planning to include (Python async):

```python
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def push_trace(trace_key, spans):
    client = AsyncClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
    await client.traces.ingest(trace_key=trace_key, spans=spans)

# migration example
old_payload = {"trace_id": "abc123", "spans": [...]} 
new_payload = {"traceKey": old_payload["trace_id"], "spans": old_payload["spans"]}
```

mike: looks good. include a short JS example too (2 lines). the docs site prefers minimal copy.

jess: added JS example and a short paragraph about why we changed the name (avoid collisions with user-level ids).

link-checker-bot: link check complete: 2 redirects found (old /trace-guide -> /observability/trace-guide). suggested to add permanent redirect rule and update relative links in 4 files.

tara: the redirect is fine but please ensure canonical URL in the snippet embed is the new one. I found one hardcoded absolute link still pointing at `/trace-guide`.

jess: fixing hardcoded link and adding a canonical meta tag to the snippet page. pushing commit in ~10m.

andrew: minor: in the dashboard screenshot the metric name is "request.latency_ms" but our dashboard uses "request.latency_ms.p95" in the example widgets. either change the widget text or annotate in the caption that we're showing p95 vs raw times.

jess: updated caption to clarify p95 and added a callout about choosing quantiles. also added a note in the rollout checklist to run a smoke query after migration.

mike: ran local build — samples render, link redirects fixed if you add the permanent redirect entry. two nits left: SDK snippet needs an explicit `await client.close()` in the async example; and the JS example should use `import { Client } from 'redwood'` style (our docs prefer named imports).

jess: added await close and switched to named import. also attached the exported dashboard SVG to the PR assets.

doc-bot: PR #813 update: checks passed (build + link-check + lint). pending: one reviewer approval.

mike: reviewed and left a small suggest change. pulling this into my review queue now. :thumbsup:

jess: thanks. @mike @tara @andrew if you can approve after the change I'll merge and backfill the redirect config in infra.

mike: approved :shipit:

tara: approved :+1:

jess: merged. will follow up with infra to add the redirect and with product to announce the migration note in the release notes. thanks all! (reaction :party_parrot:)
